title: Is a job guarantee the solution to mass AI unemployment?
hook_text: Can a job guarantee fix AI?
script:
The Guardian reports that economists are proposing government job guarantees to combat mass AI unemployment.
Advocates argue that the state must act as an employer of last resort as automation accelerates.
Traditional social safety nets face unprecedented strain from rapid labor market disruptions.
Economists debate whether publicly funded programs can absorb millions of displaced workers.
Would you support a state job guarantee if automation replaces your current role?
